notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: EO 12437 (Fuel Use Prohibitions, signed August 11, 1983, 48 FR 36801) has a single operative sentence in the held Federal Register text: "it is hereby ordered that Executive Order No. 12217 is revoked." That is a self-executing act completed when the order was issued. The order sets up no continuing duty, authority, body, report or deadline of its own, so nothing in it could be in force on 2026-10-14; its lasting effect is the revocation of EO 12217, which the U.S. Code note at 42 U.S.C. 8373 also records ("was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 12437, Aug. 11, 1983, 48 F.R. 36801"). The two history observations (the Federal Register disposition note "Revokes: EO 12217, June 18, 1980" and the 1989 codification entry) both record only that this order revoked another order, and neither shows a later event affecting EO 12437. No held text cites EO 12437 as amended, revoked or superseded. Status: no.
